Michael Conrad is a prolific writer for DC Comics. He has contributed to the storyline of Wonder Woman, Batman, Superman, Godzilla, Nightwing, Doom Patrol , and countless others. Michael’s own work has been markedly more subversive, including Tremor Dose and Double Walker . These books explore an absurd and often surreal anxiety, with a focus on an inability to reconcile one's own perceptions.
